init_seed: init random seed for numpy, torch, cuda, and cudnn with a given seed and reproducibility flag
get_config: get merged configuration dict from default, dataset, model yaml files and optional overrides
clean_text: clean raw text by removing HTML tags, special characters, and extra whitespace
num_tokens_from_string: count the number of tiktoken tokens in a text string using a specified encoding name
init_logger: initialize a file and stream logger with config-based directory structure and log filename
